# Task: phase 2, make your tests runnable against the implementation

Your test files have been copied into /ws/t2, which contains the implementation:
$files

Run them: `cd /ws/t2 && python -m pytest -q <your files>`.
You may fix ONLY setup problems: imports, fixtures, file paths, test data loading.
You may NOT change, add or remove any assert statement or assert* call. A script compares them with phase 1.
If an assertion fails, leave it failing: that is a finding, not something for you to fix.
Then write /ws/out/attempt_summary.md (at most 200 words) and finish.
